dt: Application must be submitted in full by Nov 15, 2026
e: Fellowship for women of any nationality in a full-time PhD or doctoral program in aerospace engineering or the space sciences, who have completed at least one year of the program (or hold a master's in an aerospace-applied field) and will not graduate before April 2028. Postdocs are not eligible.
unv: The page names aerospace engineering and space sciences only; whether astronomy or physics theses qualify depends on their space-science focus.
